Copyright (C) 2018-2026 WireGuard LLC

WireGuard for Windows is distributed under the MIT License.
Source: https://git.zx2c4.com/wireguard-windows/
Downloads: https://download.wireguard.com/windows-client/

The bundled MSI is an unmodified, Authenticode-signed release downloaded from
the official WireGuard download server. SkyLab Connect installs it only when
WireGuard for Windows is not already installed and does not remove it during
SkyLab Connect uninstall because other applications may share it.
